attack_summary: Brute force attack attempts on SSH logging services followed by credential access.
timeline: 2026-07-18T10:00:00Z - Failed SSH logins recorded from external IP 198.51.100.42
2026-07-18T10:05:00Z - Successful login on admin account after 15 attempts
resolution: IP blocked on firewall and admin account disabled.
lessons_learned: Enforce strict multi-factor authentication (MFA) and implement fail2ban rate-limits.
